entrypoints.control_plane: control_plane/runtime.py (SQLite persistence, leases and event history)
entrypoints.agent_runtime: agent_runtime/runtime.py (model, tools, memory and skills loop)
entrypoints.goal_intake: agent_runtime/intake.py and scripts/agent_task.py (host-authorized goal planning and bound review)
entrypoints.service_tools: agent_runtime/service_tools.py (fixed named process and HTTP adapters, host profile authorization)
entrypoints.managed_lifecycle: agent_runtime/task_lifecycle.py and scripts/agent_task_manage.py (sealed status, resume, safe control and exact file readback)
entrypoints.result_publication: agent_runtime/publication.py (generation and invocation bound result publication)
entrypoints.skill_lifecycle: agent_runtime/skill_management.py and scripts/skill_manage.py (content holdout/mutation review and controlled activation)
entrypoints.local_verification: scripts/challenge.py verify (one invocation; compact summary; current evidence reuse)
entrypoints.host_replay_receipt: scripts/host_replay.py (evidence binding only; host loading remains unverified)
entrypoints.agent_cli: scripts/agent_run.py (managed Codex/API decision loop with host acceptance)

platform_integrations.generic: explicit Skill-root install and file verification; host loading unverified
platform_integrations.zcode: Skill directory install and file verification; host loading unverified

local_runtime_status: SQLite state, leases and event history are local-only. Evidence checks are deterministic and root-scoped; semantic, UX, identity, production and external-action acceptance remain host-owned.
export_status: Self-contained Skill includes Agent Runtime, bounded task queue, project-scoped memory, parameterized tool recipes, independent acceptance, resumable checkpoints and control-plane gates. No automatic daemon, credentials or live desktop event subscription is installed.
